title: The Morning Digest: October 9, 2026
dek: Hurricane Isaias strengthened to 90 kt overnight with a Mobile-area landfall early Oct 10; BSEE shut-ins more than doubled Thursday to 1,282,879 b/d (62.89%) with 121 platforms evacuated. Thursday's session was the storm bid: WTI ~+$3.21, Brent ~+$4.08; overnight the tape gave back ~$1 on track uncertainty. The diesel crack's overnight print runs ~$111.60 (provisional). ICE (Oct 8): TMW Nov26 -$24.69, Dec26 -$25.35 still the widest tenor; ARV Nov26 -$15.93. The SPR exchange award is still pending; CFTC positioning releases today.
